description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2920012198200 STARTER,ENGINE,ELEC: Line 0001 Qty 72 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0063 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 10. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved sources are 44940 191-1550; 4BW86 M002T65771. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available.
